evidence: The deposition of NiS was carried out in the ALD chamber at 200 °C. ... Each ALD cycle consisted of one Ni(amd) 2 dose and one H2S dose, followed by 60 s of N2 purge after each dose. ... The cyclic ALD sequence for the QMS measurements was the following: 3 pulses of Ni(amd) 2, 120 s N 2 purge, 10 pulses of H 2S, and 60 s N 2 purge.
